selection: All 32 off-catalog endpoints finite-guard public final histories from the previous development campaign; both noise levels, all four physical states and bias/noise repeats. Fixed-history re-estimation, not a new closed-loop policy or held-out-material test.
scope: Uniform continuous E/preparation prior with nested randomized QMC diagnostics, plus a separate replayable outward-interval verifier of a FIXED finite-increment quasistatic model. QMC is not set containment. Interval wrapping may force abstention. Neither is a continuous-loading, inertial, image-based or real-world safety result.
